added_assumptions.label: ass:uniform-poly-time-model
added_assumptions.statement: Fix the following computational conventions, used for every complexity claim in this paper. (i) Canonical carrier and encoding: for a finite simple bow-free ADMG G on vertex set U with |U| = n, singleton target s, and positive rational cost c, the supplied total order on U induces the order isomorphism U \simeq \mathrm{Fin}\,n; the instance is encoded as the resulting \mathrm{Fin}\,n-carrier tuple (directed and bidirected adjacency bit-matrices, the index of s, and the numerators and denominators of c in binary), of encoding length L = \mathrm{poly}(n, \mathrm{bitlen}(c)). Every statement of the form 'X is computable in polynomial time' means: the induced map on canonically encoded \mathrm{Fin}\,n instances is computable in time polynomial in (n, L). (ii) Relabeling invariance: all predicates and objective values appearing in this paper (\mathcal C(G,s), r(G,s), \mathrm{LP}(G,s,c), \mathrm{OPT}(G,s,c), feasibility of an intervention set) are invariant under vertex relabeling, so a polynomial-time algorithm on the canonical \mathrm{Fin}\,n carrier transfers to any finite vertex type U via the supplied order, with the transfer costing polynomial overhead. (iii) Elementary-count translation: an algorithm performing \mathrm{poly}(n, L) elementary operations on encoded instances (graph adjacency queries, reachability and ancestor searches, comparisons and field operations on rationals of bit length \mathrm{poly}(L)) runs in time \mathrm{poly}(n, L). (iv) Closure under guarded composition: the class of polynomial-time maps on canonically encoded instances is closed under composition, in particular the composition of the private-guard expansion, the parent-spouse rounding, and the reverse guard-replacement map is polynomial time.
added_assumptions.source: Standard, universally accepted conventions of the polynomial-time model (Cobham-Edmonds thesis; closure of FP under composition; encoding-independence up to polynomial reencoding). They fix the ambient computational model the draft already presupposes and are formally necessary here only because Mathlib's `Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime` is monomorphic in its function and encoders and its composition lemma `Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime.comp` exists only as `proof_wanted`. They constrain no graph, cost, or rank; the kernel claims — the first nonempty rank boundary, the exact weighted natural-LP gap at rank three, and the UGC-conditional (2-epsilon) threshold on the sparse subclass — are untouched.

proposed_from.topic: First-nonzero residual-hedge-rank frontier for minimum-cost causal experiment design. In finite simple bow-free semi-Markovian ADMGs with singleton target s and positive rational intervention costs, classify four-vertex hedges as complementary directed and bidirected spanning paths and prove r<=2 is hedge-free. For every ordered simple source graph H, use vertices x_u and one private guard z_e per edge e={u,v}, edges x_u->x_v->z_e->s, z_e<->x_u, and global s<->x_u spokes to prove the minimal residual-hedge clutter is exactly {{x_u,x_v,z_e}:e in E(H)}. Transfer unit-cost vertex cover to obtain NP/APX hardness at r=3 on bidirected trees of radius two. Prove a polynomial weighted factor-two LP rounding theorem, matching integrality-gap supremum two, and UGC-conditional (2-epsilon) hardness. Add promised-rank enumeration, scoped bounded-cardinality search, and an optimizer-or-rank-violation interface; do not claim unrestricted rank recognition or unconstrained weighted 3^k optimization. Consumer: Elahi et al.'s RC2/Gurobi workflow and Akbari et al.'s min_cost_intervention software. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: For every ordered H, every hedge contains a suffix x_v->z_e->s and bidirected connectivity forces its designated x_u; every intended triple is a four-vertex hedge. Guard replacement preserves vertex-cover optimum with unit costs. Edge counting classifies the first bow-free singleton hedge rank, parent/spouse rounding gives factor two, and complete-graph expansions match the LP gap. Exhaustive checks covered all 1,099 source graphs through five vertices and 1,900,363 residual subsets, plus K3,3 and the triangular prism; no unintended minimal hedge appeared. Rank-four and weighted-cardinality counterexamples removed two overclaims. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Independently or formally verify the universal reverse-inclusion theorem and rank-three parent/spouse rounding argument; the draft has complete informal proofs but is not Lean-checked. EARLY KILL TEST: Reimplement ancestry/connectivity enumeration independently through five source vertices and the named cubic cases; any hedge containing no intended triple kills the reduction. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/exp_mcid_hedgerank_three_boundary.md.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The two closest results are Akbari, Etesami, and Kiyavash's bounded-hedge theorem and Elahi and coauthors' solver formulation. The strict delta from the former is an exact bow-free singleton classification showing that residual ranks one and two are empty, followed by exact realization of every graph edge clutter at rank three with one private guard and a radius-two bidirected tree. The strict delta from the latter is a proved polynomial weighted factor-two approximation, a matching causal LP-gap family, and a conditional lower bound, rather than a faster exact encoding or heuristic. The theorem does not advertise generic hitting-set enumeration or LP solving as novel. Bounded searches through September 2026 found no closer paper that states the same rank-three representability or approximation frontier.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction on pages 1--3; Theorem 2 and its gadget discussion on pages 7--8 with the proof in Appendix C; Appendix D.2 on pages 45--46; nonlinear-cost discussion on page 20.
seed_details.opportunity: Classify the first nonempty bow-free singleton residual rank, realize graph edge clutters exactly, and derive the tight approximation frontier.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the two-auxiliary general hardness hedge by a one-private-guard construction and prove reverse inclusion for all overlapping source edges.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for rank-three hedge approximation, bounded hedge size three, and factor-two MCID returned the Akbari and Elahi papers but no occupied theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from bounded-rank hitting set because rank three gives a factor-three algorithm.
seed_details.rebuttal: The causal parent-spouse crossing yields factor two, and exact graph-edge realization gives a matching lower bound; neither follows from generic three-hitting set.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction and drug-interaction motivation on pages 1--2; Theorems 1--2 on pages 4--5; alternating ancestry and district SAT proof in Appendix C; conclusion on page 9.
seed_details.opportunity: Build a promised-rank front end that returns an exact or approximate optimizer, or a minimal hedge witnessing violation of the rank promise.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Turn the alternating ancestry and district recursion encoded in SAT into a direct fixed-point separation and minimal-witness oracle.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for MCID rank certificates and optimizer-or-hedge interfaces found solver encodings but no rank-violation guarantee.
seed_details.red_team: A solver can already report infeasibility, so the certificate is routine.
seed_details.rebuttal: The relaxation is always feasible; the new output is a causally valid minimal residual larger than the promised rank, not an optimization infeasibility certificate.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction and APX program; Theorem 3.1 and its cubic-graph \(L\)-reduction; concluding list of cubic APX-complete problems. The primary full-text host was intermittently inaccessible, so the load-bearing theorem was cross-checked against the journal metadata and the cited theorem statement.
seed_details.opportunity: Determine whether rank-three MCID stays hard when the mixed skeleton is planar and every vertex, including the target, has bounded mixed degree.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace global target spokes by planar local confounding connectors while preserving exact hedge realization.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches combining planar ADMG, bounded degree, hedge, and MCID found planar node-cover hardness but no causal gadget satisfying both restrictions.
seed_details.red_team: Planar cubic vertex-cover hardness transfers by simply applying the private-guard gadget.
seed_details.rebuttal: The target spokes create a nonplanar high-degree hub, so the existing realization destroys both destination restrictions at the first causal construction step.

seed_details.anchor_read: Introduction on pages 1--3; Theorem 14 and nested-IPW construction on pages 28--29 with its proof in Appendix H; discussion of unresolved tangent spaces on page 12.
seed_details.opportunity: Jointly select identifying proxy laws and allocate samples to minimize fixed acquisition cost plus an efficiency-bound criterion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive one product-model influence function valid across a combinatorially selected collection of interventional laws before optimizing allocation.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for semiparametric efficiency with proxy experiment selection found influence-function inference for fixed identified graphs and allocation work for direct ATE experiments, but no coupled problem.
seed_details.red_team: Optimize MCID first and apply Neyman allocation afterward.
seed_details.rebuttal: Different feasible proxy collections induce different influence functions and information, so fixed cost and allocation are generally nonseparable.

seed_details.anchor_read: Abstract and introduction describing the multilayered PCP; the \(k-1-\epsilon\) hypergraph-cover theorem and biased-long-code proof architecture; conclusion and comparison to the easy factor \(k\).
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize rank-four causal-clutter realizability and decide whether the causal approximation ratio inherits or beats four-uniform hypergraph cover.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Realize every source hyperedge as exactly one minimal residual hedge without creating smaller obstruction sets.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for rank-four causal hedge realizability returned generic hypergraph-cover bounds but no ADMG representation theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Akbari's general hitting-set reduction already realizes arbitrary rank-four clutters.
seed_details.rebuttal: Its auxiliaries and minimality interactions do not preserve exact residual rank four in the bow-free singleton class, so the approximation gap does not transfer automatically.

seed_details.anchor_read: Section 3.3 on hedge enumeration, the alternating hedge-hull algorithms, Appendix D.2 on bounded size, and the discussion of general enumeration limits.
seed_details.opportunity: Classify recognition of \(r(G,s)\leq3\), with minimal large hedges as coNP certificates.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Move from enumerating all small candidate hedges to excluding every larger inclusion-minimal hedge through a structural certificate or hardness reduction.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for residual hedge rank recognition and minimal hedge size complexity found no published classification.
seed_details.red_team: Enumerate triples and check whether they cover all hedges.
seed_details.rebuttal: A feasible triple-hitting solution does not exclude a larger minimal hedge, so small-set enumeration is not a rank recognizer.

seed_details.anchor_read: Section 5 on nonlinear costs, Proposition 5, the loss of logarithmic approximation, and the transition to evaluations.
seed_details.opportunity: Determine the approximation frontier at rank three for monotone submodular or bundle-dependent acquisition costs.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace linear threshold charging by a Lovasz-extension or value-oracle argument compatible with the parent-spouse crossing structure.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for nonlinear-cost MCID approximation found only the general cost discussion and no rank-three result.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objective is a set cost rather than a submodular coverage constraint, and the tight rank-three ratio depends on how bundle costs interact with the two-part residual structure.

seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 1 and Appendix C's alternating reachability construction; Section 5 experiments; conclusion identifying approximation as future work.
seed_details.opportunity: Enumerate promised-rank minimal hedges exactly once with polynomial delay and a canonical state quotient, then expose them incrementally to exact solvers.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Prove a right-congruence for ancestry and district search states so distinct traces with identical future minimal completions can be merged.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: Searches for canonical hedge enumeration and polynomial-delay MCID found SAT encodings and fixed-size subset enumeration, not an exact-once delay theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Lexicographically testing all bounded-size subsets already gives exact-once output.
seed_details.rebuttal: That baseline has polynomial total time only for fixed rank; the stronger seed concerns delay, quotientable search states, and incremental solver access, which require a causal right-congruence.

seed_details.anchor_read: Theorem 2 and Appendix C's vertex-cover reduction; Appendix D.2's bounded-rank discussion.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the causal LP gap of private-guard expansions by the fractional chromatic number of the source graph.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Project the causal covering LP onto the source vertex-cover LP.
seed_details.destination_pair_search: The source target-method pair is already occupied by Singh's exact formula.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Singh's formula once the causal LP projection is written down.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds: exact projection makes this a corollary rather than a standalone kernel.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Rejected as a single-comparator equivalence with no derived divergence frontier.
